learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G001】五大基本句型（SV, SVO, SVC, SVOO, SVOC）与动词配价边界；【G006】核心介词规约搭配与名/动/形+介词固定结构。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP010】图表、坐标轴、斜率与分布形态的精准描述，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 五大基本句型（SV, SVO, SVC, SVOO, SVOC）与动词配价边界
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 英语句子的核心骨架由谓语动词的及物性与配价决定：不及物动词构成 SV（Evidence accumulates / A problem arose），系动词构成 SVC（The label is meaningless），单及物动词构成 SVO（The team abandoned the approach），双及物动词构成 SVOO，复合宾语动词构成 SVOC（The pronoun makes the final sentence ambiguous）。严禁把不及物动词当及物动词用，或把及物动词误加介词。
rules: 不及物动词（arise, emerge, occur, differ, fluctuate, accumulate, oscillate）后不直接接名词宾语，需用状语或介词短语扩展。
单及物动词（address, discuss, access, affect, investigate, assess, warrant）直接接宾语，禁止按中文习惯误加介词（禁止写 *discuss about, *address to, *access to 作动词）。
SVOC 结构中宾语补足语用形容词或分词说明宾语状态（keep the room temperature constant, make the task easier）。
examples: SV: A problem arose when the data formats changed.
SVO: This paper addresses unequal access to educational resources.
SVC: Without a clear definition, the label is meaningless.
SVOC: The pronoun makes the final sentence ambiguous.
common_errors: 误将不及物动词用于被动或直接加宾语：*A problem was arisen / *differ two groups。
在及物动词后添加冗余介词：*discuss about the findings / *address to the limitation。
SVOC 中误用副词作宾补：*keep the room temperature constantly（应为 constant）。

grammar_instruction.name: 核心介词规约搭配与名/动/形+介词固定结构
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 学术词汇的介词搭配高度固定，且同一词族的名词、动词和形容词常要求不同介词（如 access a database [v.] vs access to services [n.] vs accessible to users [adj.]；emphasise the need [v.] vs place emphasis on [n.]）。
rules: 动词+介词固定搭配：account for, attribute A to B, base A on B, confine A to B, consist of, contribute to, correlate with, decompose A into B, depend on, differ from, disentangle A from B, draw on, focus on, incorporate A into B, rely on, stem from。

名词/形容词+介词精确方向：change in (某指标变化) vs change of (更换)；increase/decrease in (指标) vs of (数值)；attributable to, akin to, amenable to, analogous to, compatible with, consistent with, invariant under, proportional to, superior to, synonymous with。
当 to 为介词时（an approach to, contribute to, be devoted to, prior to, with regard to, amenable to, receptive to, subject to），后接动词必须用动名词（-ing）！
examples: The team developed an approach to handling missing observations.
The simplified model is amenable to analytical treatment.
The distance between two points is invariant under a common translation.
common_errors: 把介词 to 误当成不定式符号：*an approach to handle / *contribute to improve / *be devoted to solve。
介词错配：*superior than（应为 superior to）、*synonymous to（应为 synonymous with）、*attributable for（应为 attributable to）。

grammar_instruction.name: 数值、比例、分位数、矩阵量纲与增减幅度的精确语法
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 定量描述必须严格区分“差值（by）”、“终值（to）”、“比例（proportion/percentage）”、“比值（ratio）”、“百分点（percentage points）”以及“均值（mean）、中位数（median）、众数（mode）、中程数（midrange）”。
rules: 动词 + by + 差值（decreased by 5 units） vs 动词 + to + 终值（decreased to 15）；名词 + of + 变化量（growth of 10%） vs 名词 + in + 变化对象（growth in demand）。
从 20% 升至 25% 是 an increase of 5 percentage points（绝对百分点变化），而相对增幅为 25%（relative percentage change）。
double 表示增至两倍，halve 表示减半（不可写 *halve by half）；midrange 是 (min+max)/2，median 是排序后居中的分位数（0.5 quantile），二者绝不可混同。
examples: The count increased by ten, from twenty to thirty.
A rise from 20% to 25% is five percentage points.
For the values 7, 8, 8, 8, 11 and 12, the midrange is 9.5, whereas the median is 8.
common_errors: 介词 by 与 to 混用导致差值与终值颠倒。
把 percentage point（百分点）与 per cent（百分比）混同。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 图表、坐标轴、斜率与分布形态的精准描述
expression_pattern_instruction.template: In Figure [N], plotting [Y] against [X] reveals [pattern/slope], while the shaded band denotes [uncertainty interval].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于论文结果部分与雅思小作文（Task 1），准确说明横纵轴、单位与误差带。
examples: In the figure, a shaded band denotes the observation interval.
common_errors: plot A against B 中颠倒纵轴 A 与横轴 B 的关系。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 严辨统计相关与因果机制（Correlation vs. Causality & Confounding）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: Although [Variable X] correlates with [Outcome Y], predictive accuracy alone cannot establish causality due to potential unmeasured confounding.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于机器学习可解释性、医疗/社会科学数据分析，严格划清相关与因果的界限。
examples: A correlation between two variables does not by itself establish a causal relationship.
Unmeasured confounding may bias an estimated treatment effect.
common_errors: 将特征重要性或滞后相关性直接称为因果作用。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：本词条article为名词，about引出主题；about常用于一般话题，on常用于具体专题，二者并非绝对互斥。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We read an article about community archives.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：本词条article为名词，on引出主题；about常用于一般话题，on常用于具体专题，二者并非绝对互斥。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The seminar discusses an article on water policy.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：因果解释需证据。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The session was cancelled as a result of a power failure.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：表示通常做法，不是强制性规章的同义词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As a rule, students discuss major revisions with their supervisor.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：通常紧随整体对象，区别于 on the whole 的概括语气。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The sample as a whole is more diverse than either subgroup.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不用 as it can be seen in；若未提供表只为语言例句。
key_collocations: as can be seen in Table 1
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As can be seen in Table 1, the groups differ in size.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：与较简洁的compared with意义接近。
key_collocations: as compared to the previous year
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Rainfall was higher as compared to the previous year.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：concerned 前用 be；填入对象后保持完整结构。
key_collocations: as far as the design is concerned
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As far as the design is concerned, the groups are comparable.

scheduled_review_words.meaning_zh: 如已展示或证明的那样
scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不要把展示结果写成普遍证明。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As has been shown in Table 2, attendance varied by site.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：后接名词或动名词；使对比对象形式平行。
key_collocations: observed values as opposed to predictions
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The table reports observed values as opposed to predictions.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00190 phrase] 关于（例：As regards data storage, the protocol requires encryption.）；[V00191 介词短语] 关于；就…而言（例：As regards the timetable, the department has made no changes.） | 本条用法约束：较正式；regards 带 s。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As regards data storage, the protocol requires encryption.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00190 phrase] 关于（例：As regards data storage, the protocol requires encryption.）；[V00191 介词短语] 关于；就…而言（例：As regards the timetable, the department has made no changes.） | 本条用法约束：直接接名词短语，不加 to。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As regards the timetable, the department has made no changes.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：只有幻灯片实际呈现时才用。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As this slide shows, response rates differ by age group.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00193 clause] 如前所述或所见（例：As we have seen, the two estimates use different denominators.）；[V00194 discourse phrase] 如我们已经看到的（例：As we have seen above, the rule has limitations.） | 本条用法约束：只能指已解释的信息。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As we have seen, the two estimates use different denominators.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00193 clause] 如前所述或所见（例：As we have seen, the two estimates use different denominators.）；[V00194 discourse phrase] 如我们已经看到的（例：As we have seen above, the rule has limitations.） | 本条用法约束：现在完成式回指已讨论内容。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As we have seen above, the rule has limitations.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：真实回指，不能指未出现的证据。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: As we saw in Section 2, the criteria differ.
